methodology.first_release_growth: Headline monthly real-GDP growth in dated Statistics Canada The Daily releases.
methodology.revised_growth: Growth computed from current runtime historical level series.
methodology.scope: Pilot focused on the first four post-common-gate observations (May-August 2020).

source.official: Statistics Canada The Daily + real-time table 36-10-0491-01

result.conclusion: No sign flip in this four-month CAD GDP pilot, but revisions change the magnitude of the growth impulse. The direction signal appears robust here; normalized impulse strength can still move.

next: Extend CAD GDP through the full 2020-2026 monthly sample, then test whether revised-vs-first-release differences alter blockDynamics direction/turning thresholds.
